cause: Core control tracing already recovered the supplied targets, but source-quality reconstructed WORD dispatches separately using adjacent/shallow instruction recognizers. That lost separated load/LEA/JMP and address-index relationships before typed table rendering.
implementation: Sparse source-coordinate relative-dispatch contracts are emitted only after the existing control-use trace validates a WORD table prefix. Source-quality consumes these contracts and rechecks final code/data ownership.
Shared trace transport preserves raw WORD relations through register copies, sign-extends MOVEA.W/EXT.L explicitly and refuses unknown upper bits for LONG indexing. PC-indexed LEA supports Dn and An.

The old adjacent/shallow WORD dispatch recognizers and their helper scan are removed. The distinct existing keyed-LONG lane is retained. No Starglider addresses, names, patterns or manual per-table declarations are added to framework code.

Final projection splits at existing labels, preserves biased leading entries, rejects incompatible typed owners/ambiguous bases and distinguishes physical extent from local mask/compare evidence. Signed BGT without a nonnegative premise does not create a zero-based domain.

coverage: Dn load/LEA/JMP with intervening instructions and source-register clobber after pointer construction
An WORD load, LONG register copy and separated PC-indexed JMP
WORD copies, MOVEA.W and explicit EXT.L sign extension, An-indexed LEA
Unknown LONG upper bits, EXT.W, BYTE overwrite, unknown destination clobber, arithmetic ADD mistaken for a load and numeric lookup without control use remain unpromoted
Incompatible LONG ownership and independently accepted code ownership do not become relative tables
Signed upper-bound comparison alone retains unknown/non-zero-based selector domain
Existing direct/ADDA, biased leading-entry, mask/compare and preserved-call dispatch fixtures remain passing
